title: AlphaAlign: Incentivizing Safety Alignment with Extremely Simplified Reinforcement Learning
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of safety alignment in LLMs, specifically aiming to prevent the generation of harmful content and jailbreak success while reducing over-refusal. While it discusses 'ethical norms' and 'unethical behavior' (such as cheating on exams) in its case studies and uses the CoCoNot benchmark which includes ethically grounded cases, its primary focus is AI safety and adversarial robustness rather than a systematic evaluation of religion, morals, or philosophical ethical frameworks.
